critique: The lime-green Streaklet line rendering on black is clean, layered, and visibly animated between t1 and t4. However, both frames remain dominated by extremely long, cropped parallel arcs that span edge-to-edge. The twist is only a shallow crossing region rather than a compact, legible curled focal mass, and at t4 it reads especially as an open fan of ribbons. This does not yet convincingly match a focused Streaklet Twist preset composition.

suggestions.why: Reduce the base shape X span so the streaks no longer run as oversized edge-to-edge ribbons and the twisted structure remains contained within the frame.
Increase the Twister amount to produce a more obvious curled convergence and stronger central twist after the overall streak span is reduced.
